title: Oops, I’m talking about Just in Time again 😅. I have not stopped thin...
transcript: I wanna talk about Isa Briones is in just in time, because while a lot of you may know her as Doctor Santos from the Pitt, a lot of people don't realise that she is also a musical theatre girly. She was in Hamilton, she was in Hadestown and now she's in just in time. And I was absolutely blown away by her performance. There's just something about her voice that makes her so perfect for Connie Francis. It just has a very classic tone to it that feels like the style of singing that you would hear in the sixties. You haven't seen one of the millions of videos going viral online right now There is one on my profile. And I actually think the combination of her casting with Matthew Morrison does make the show feel a lot more like a period piece, rather than super contemporary like it did with Jonathan and Gracie. And don't get me wrong, I loved Gracie Lawrence's performance in the show, but her voice is very modern, very contemporary, and I loved hearing a more classic sound in this role. And her acting as well is unsurprisingly excellent. She is able to infuse this role with so much personality. And you really do believe the second that you meet her that this person is going to go on to be a massive star. And in the same way, I think ISA Briones is going to go on to be a massive star. And so Go check her out in just in time to say I saw her when.
classificationReason: Creator personally saw Isa Briones in Just in Time and shares a detailed opinion of her performance ('I was absolutely blown away by her performance'). Compares her to previous cast members with first-hand insight, and discusses how her casting affects the show's overall feel. Clearly a review.
